settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Choose the language of the interface.
settings.modeHint: Switch between the desktop window and the console-style Big Picture mode.
settings.keyInvalid: SteamGridDB rejected this key. Check it and try again.
settings.steamArtHint: Which images Lutra shows for your Steam games.
settings.fallbackHint: When SteamGridDB has no image for a game, use the one from Steam.
settings.steamGridDbHint: Custom images, and images of games you add yourself, come from SteamGridDB. A free API key is required.
settings.defaultRunnerHint: Preselected when you add a game.
settings.prefixesHint: Each game gets its own prefix, so one game cannot break another.
settings.toolsHint: Lutra uses these when a game asks for them.
settings.appLogHint: What Lutra did and what went wrong: scans, artwork, launches.
settings.aboutHint: A unified game library and launcher for Linux: Steam, Windows games and native games in one place.
settings.licenseHint: Free software: you may use, study, change and share it.

tabsHint.general: Language, display mode and rendering of the app.
tabsHint.windows: Wine, Proton and the tools that run your Windows games.
tabsHint.artwork: Where the covers, banners and logos of your games come from.
tabsHint.logs: What Lutra did, to understand what went wrong.
tabsHint.about: Lutra, its version and its licence.

settings.trayClose: Closing the window keeps Lutra running
settings.trayCloseHint: Lutra stays in the notification area; its icon reopens or quits it.
settings.trayGamesHint: The window hides when a game starts and comes back when it ends.
settings.trayStartHint: Lutra starts in the notification area without opening its window.
settings.trayMissingHint: Your desktop does not show one: Lutra's window is never hidden, so it stays reachable.
settings.soundsHint: Short sounds when you move through menus, confirm, go back or switch a setting.

empty.title: No games yet
empty.hint: Install a game on Steam, then scan again. Your library fills itself.

addGame.title: Add a game
addGame.hint: Pick the game's program. Lutra fills in its details and runs it for you.
addGame.name: Name
addGame.noRunner: No Wine or Proton found. Install Wine, or Proton from Steam, then reopen this window.
addGame.linuxHint: A Linux program: a binary, an AppImage or a script.
addGame.optimized: Optimized for this machine automatically (graphics card, synchronisation, GameMode). You can fine-tune it in the game's settings.
addGame.folderInstead: Got a whole folder of games?

config.title: {{title}} settings
config.esyncHint: Faster synchronisation between threads. Leave on unless a game misbehaves.
config.fsyncHint: Even faster than Esync, needs a recent kernel.
config.virtualDesktopHint: Runs the game in a window of this size, like 1920x1080. Empty to disable.
config.arch32Hint: For old games. Only applies before the prefix is created.
config.dllOverridesHint: Which DLLs Wine takes from the game folder. Format: name=n,b separated by semicolons.
config.argsHint: Passed to the game as you type them. Use quotes around values with spaces.
config.envHint: Extra variables set when the game starts.
config.gamemodeHint: Asks Linux for maximum performance while the game runs.
config.mangohudHint: Shows an overlay with FPS and system load.
config.debugHint: Writes everything Wine says to the launch log. Very verbose.
config.artworkHint: Search SteamGridDB below and pick the matching game.
config.artworkNone: No game found. Try another name.
config.artworkNoKey: Add your SteamGridDB key in Settings to search artwork.
config.artworkFailed: The search failed. Check your connection.
config.subtitle: {{source}} · Settings
config.prefixLater: It will be created on the first launch.
config.runnerHint: Proton is usually the safest choice for recent games.
config.artworkNoMatch: No matching game found on SteamGridDB.

logs.empty: Nothing logged yet. Launch the game to see its output here.

controllers.title: Controllers
controllers.subtitle: Lutra drives your controllers, like Steam Input: it presents them to games and the rest of the system as an Xbox or PlayStation controller, with your own settings.
controllers.noUinputHint: Your system does not let applications create input devices. Run this once in a terminal, then reconnect your controller:
controllers.noneHint: Plug a controller in or pair it over Bluetooth: it appears here on its own.
controllers.testHint: Test mode: open any game or controller tester to try it.
controllers.testFailed: Could not start the virtual controller:

outputHint.xbox360: Works with almost every PC game. Games show Xbox buttons.
outputHint.ds4: Shows PlayStation buttons, but Windows games only see it through DirectInput: most of them (Unity, Unreal…) read Xbox controllers only and will find nothing. Choose Automatic if the game does not react.
outputHint.none: Lutra leaves the controller alone: none of the settings below apply.
outputHint.auto: Lutra picks what the game understands: an Xbox 360 pad for Windows games (they only read Xbox controllers), your own controller type otherwise.
outputHint.keyboard: No gamepad at all: buttons and sticks become keys and mouse movements, for games without controller support. Choose them below.

controllers.deadzoneHint: Ignores small movements around the centre. Raise it if your character moves on its own.
controllers.rightCurveHint: Makes small right stick movements finer, for precise aiming.
controllers.invertRightYHint: Pushing up looks down, like a flight stick.
controllers.triggerDeadzoneHint: Ignores a finger resting on a trigger.
controllers.rumbleHint: Passes the game's vibrations on to your controller.
controllers.swapFaceHint: Swaps A/B and X/Y, for controllers that print them the other way round.
controllers.remapHint: Choose what the game receives for each button: another button, or a key or mouse button. Press a button on your controller to find its line.
controllers.navigationHint: Move with the stick or the D-pad, confirm with the bottom button, go back with the right one.
controllers.defaultScope: These settings apply to every game that has no profile of its own.
controllers.gameCustom: Use settings for this game only
controllers.gameCustomHint: Otherwise the game uses the default settings from the Controllers screen.
controllers.stickModeHint: Turn a stick into the mouse or into direction keys, for games that have no controller support.
controllers.mouseSpeedHint: How fast the pointer moves when the stick is pushed all the way.

state.idleHint: The controller is handed to a game when it starts, and comes back when it closes.
state.systemHint: Everywhere, the controller follows your default settings. Each game launched from Lutra gets its own.
state.steamHint: Steam is open and already drives the controller. Lutra takes it back for games launched from Lutra.

controllers.systemHint: Like Steam: applications and games launched outside Lutra see a corrected controller (dead zones, drift recentring, remapped buttons). Lutra steps aside while Steam is open.
controllers.noUhid: Games will show Xbox buttons for the PlayStation 4 controller
controllers.noUhidHint: For games to treat the virtual PS4 controller as a real one (PlayStation buttons), Lutra must be able to create HID devices. Run this once in a terminal:

remapScreen.title: Remap buttons
remapScreen.press: Press the button that {{button}} should act as.
remapScreen.hint: Click a button, then press the one it should act as. Or remap them all in turn.
remapScreen.noController: Connect a controller to press its buttons, or pick what each one does from the list.

battery.label: Battery
battery.alert: {{name}} is at {{percent}} %. Plug it in soon.

details.noMatch: No match found. You can fill the details in yourself.
details.lookupFailed: Could not reach GameDB. You can fill the details in yourself.
details.dateInvalid: Use the form 2018-09-28, or just the year.
details.title: About the game
details.lookupHint: Looks for "{{title}}" online. Picking a match replaces the fields above; you can still edit them.

prefix.newHint: Created on the first launch. The safest choice.
prefix.browseHint: Pick a prefix or an empty folder.
prefix.incompatible: Made by {{made}}: cannot be used with {{runner}}

perf.optimizeHint: Picks the graphics card, synchronisation and GameMode that suit this computer.
perf.gpuHint: The card the game renders on. Pick the discrete one for the best performance.
perf.gpuSingle: This computer has a single graphics card.
perf.gpuSystemHint: The dedicated GPU when there is one, the only one the game sees
perf.gpuPrimary: Displays the desktop (usually the integrated one)
perf.fpsLimitHint: Keeps the game from running faster than needed: less heat, steadier frames.
perf.hudHint: Shows FPS and more over the game (DXVK).
perf.hudDetailed: FPS, frame times and GPU load
perf.nvapiHint: Lets games use DLSS and other NVIDIA-only features.
perf.waylandHint: Runs the game without XWayland. Not every game likes it.
perf.fsrHint: Lets a lower resolution fill the screen in fullscreen.
perf.ntsyncHint: The kernel's own synchronisation: lower CPU use than fsync.
perf.ntsyncMissing: Not available: the kernel has no /dev/ntsync.
perf.tweaksHint: Shader cache and threaded OpenGL. Good for every game.
perf.gamescopeHint: Runs the game in its own window with upscaling and a fixed resolution.
perf.gamescopeSizeHint: What the game renders at, and the size of the window.
perf.gamescopeFsrHint: Sharper picture at a lower render resolution.

install.installerHint: The game's installer (setup.exe). It opens in its own window; Lutra then finds the game it installed.
install.optimized: The installer runs in the prefix chosen below, with settings suited to this machine.
install.runningHint: Follow its steps in its own window. Lutra continues when it closes.
install.failed: The installer reported a problem. You can still pick the game's program below if it was installed.
install.programHint: What the installer added, the likeliest first.
install.noneFound: No new program was found. Pick the game's program yourself.

remove.everythingHint: The game, its Wine prefix, its logs and its controller profile are deleted for good.
remove.prefixHint: Frees the disk space. Save games and anything installed in the prefix will be lost.
